segs.text: Section thirty nine. Every pharmacogenomics term through frequencies. Her objective, define pharmacogenomics terminology, covers every term on every slide, not only the terms the objectives name.

That covers the history and the current uses and limitations of pharmacogenomics. Then the terms: wild type, variant, polymorphism, rare variant, S N P, allele, homozygous, heterozygous, genotype, phenotype, functional significance, haplotype, linkage disequilibrium, allele and genotype frequency, and Hardy Weinberg equilibrium.
